==================================================
[PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (3) If the child is under the age of 16, the deed poll must be executed by a person having parental responsibility for him. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (4) If the child has attained the age of 16, the deed poll must, except in the case of a person mentioned in paragraph (2), be executed by a person having parental responsibility for the child and be endorsed with the child’s consent signed in both his old and new names and duly witnessed. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (5) The application for enrolment must be supported:

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (a) by a witness statement showing that the change of name is for the benefit of the child; and –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (i) that the application is submitted by all persons having parental responsibility for the child; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (ii) that it is submitted by one person having parental responsibility for the child with the consent of every other person; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (iii) that it is submitted by one person having parental responsibility for the child without the consent of every other such person, or by some other person whose name and capacity are given, for reasons set out in the affidavit; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (b) by such other evidence, if any, as the Master of the Rolls may require in the particular circumstances of the case. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (6) Regulation 4(2) shall not apply but the statutory declaration mentioned in regulation 4(1) shall state how long the householder has known the deponent under paragraph (5)(a) and the child respectively. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (7) Regulation 6 shall not apply to a child who has not attained the age of 16. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] (8) In this regulation ‘parental responsibility’ has the meaning given in section 3 of the Children Act 1989. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] 9 The Enrolment of Deeds (Change of Name) Regulations 1983 and the Enrolment of Deeds (Change of Name) (Amendment) Regulations 1990 are hereby revoked. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 5A – COURT DOCUMENTS > 8] Updated: Tuesday, 7 February 2023
